scripts.check: biome check . && tsc --noEmit && npm run style && npm test && knip && node scripts/package.ts --verify && node scripts/codex-agents.ts --check && node scripts/build-server.ts --check && node scripts/dashboard.ts --check && node scripts/build-helper.ts --check && sidecut-version --check
scripts.build: node scripts/build-server.ts && node scripts/dashboard.ts && node scripts/codex-agents.ts && node scripts/build-helper.ts

keep.knip.json: Knip's settings for the unused-code step in npm run check.
keep..claude: Project Claude Code settings: the session-start hook that installs dependencies in cloud sessions.
keep..codex: Solo's agent profiles for Codex in this repo, generated by codex-agents.
keep.REPO_SYNC .gitignore: Solo tracks its own Codex agent profiles in .codex/agents/, so its .gitignore leaves out the template's .codex/agents/ line.
keep.dogfood: Scrubbed example records; the saved runs are in the private sidecut-solo-dogfood repo.
keep.REPO_SYNC scripts/release.ts: The pinned Sidecut Agentskills workflow supplies the shared release publisher.
